sarah: Quick follow-up: proposal for a tiny admit hint header + opt-in resume trailer for long streams. Goal: non-disruptive signal for SDKs and sampled telemetry for ops.

alex: Two quick concerns: perf hit in hot dispatch and tenant privacy on shared clusters.

sarah: Perf: single atomic read for queue depth at dispatch, no alloc unless sampled. Gate with feature flag `edge.admit_hints`. Privacy: header numeric-only, e.g. `X-Edge-Admit: lvl=2;q=38;win=5`.

jamie: Semantic mapping? How should clients behave at different lvls?

sarah: Suggest: lvl=0 healthy, 1 advisory (hint), 2 constrained (prefer retry/backoff), 3 shed (gateway may reject non-priority). SDKs: ignore lvl=1 by default.

mike: Streaming: if we checkpoint mid-stream, trailer needed. Token format and billing?

sarah: Trailer gated per-route: `Edge-Resume: tok=base64url...;off=1536;exp=300`. Token includes model-version digest + window id + HMAC. Billing: resume billed from resume offset forward; metadata TTL small (default 5m). Single-use optional for sensitive routes.

jamie: Observability: aggregate histograms (q depth, admit lat) scraped periodically; sample traces at admit when lvl>=2 or trailer emitted. Dashboards: "Ingress admit heatmap". Alert if lvl>=2 sustained >60s.

ops-bot: RFC-1491 staged to edge-canary-1; canary 02:00 UTC, 10% traffic.

sarah: I'll push a short RFC with header/trailer schema, sampling rules, and flags. Alex will run microbench. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
